findings.title: Remove the half-order overlap discriminant guard
findings.status: proved in this pass with independent challenger derivation
findings.exact_statement: For A>=1, J(y;tau)=y He_A(y)-tau He_A'(y). Every nonreal repeated-root parameter satisfies |1-tau|^2>(A+1)/A. Real repeated-root parameters are precisely tau=0 for odd A, and tau=-1/A for even A. Thus tau!=0 and |1-tau|<=sqrt((A+1)/A) imply squarefreeness. If d=3 mod4, b=(d-1)/2, and Disc(U)Res(z^d+1,U)!=0 for U=H_b/(z+1) at primitive omega, then the simple-overlap local discriminant theorem holds for every A>=1 without its former Disc(J) hypothesis. Using the inherited uniform resonance theorem, the residual resultant and g guards are automatic for half-order overlap, so only H_b squarefreeness remains. For every prime d=3 mod4, the inherited prime-order squarefreeness theorem therefore gives the exact overlap formula and order unconditionally for every A>=1.
proof_changes: Pair the real Hermite roots to represent He_A'(y)/(y He_A(y)) as a rational Stieltjes transform of positive masses at nonnegative squared zeros.
Use repeated-root equation and Hermite ODE to derive z=(2A+1)-A sigma-(A+1)/sigma; compare imaginary signs.
Handle all real tau using f'(z)<0, and y=0 separately by parity.
Use existing reciprocal parameter identity with complex conjugation to get |1-tau|=1.

findings.title: Separate cyclotomic coordinate valuations and their carry
findings.status: proved in this pass; challenger checked exact quotient source and common prime
findings.exact_statement: Let s and p both be 1 mod4, p prime, c_s!=0 and p not dividing s*c_s, N=sp. For d_N=content rem_PhiN(Disc H_((N-1)/2)), r_N=content rem_PhiN Res(z^N+1,H_((N-1)/2)), c_N=content rem_PhiN of their product: v_p(d_N)=floor(s(p-3)/8), v_p(r_N)=floor(N/4), v_p(c_N)=floor(3s(p-1)/8); the last exceeds the sum of the first two iff p=1 mod8, by exactly one.
proof_changes: Keep two separate exact integer factorizations rather than only their product.
Use J_N(q)=product_j H_n(-q^j;q), which equals the cluster resultant only at q=zeta_N.
Both quotient factors are units at the same lower prime; their minimum upper valuations therefore add.
Take floors after division by e=p-1 and compute the fractional carry.
findings.normalization_warning: All contents mean gcd of integral power-basis coordinates in Z[zeta_N], or canonical remainder coefficients. Ordinary content in Z[q] is multiplicative; this theorem does not contradict Gauss lemma.
resolved_next_checks: Uniform explanation of extra ramified coefficient divisor after cyclotomic reduction.
findings.significance: Useful arithmetic normalization and exact corollary, not a new general ramification theory.
findings.novelty_caveat: The existing theorem already implies the product exponent; new contribution is clean separate-factor/carry formulation and proof, modest in depth.

findings.title: Certify exact common-cycle pole minima from lower-order content
findings.status: proved synthesis of accepted inputs, with new guard simplification
findings.exact_statement: If N=sp, either s and p both 1 mod4 with p not dividing s*c_s^sep, or s and p both 3 mod4 with p not dividing s*c_s^pair, then H_((N-1)/2)(z;zeta_N) is squarefree and the fixed scalar common-cycle first-order resolvent bank with free delta I has exact Qmin=(N-1)/2. Delta is forced by the displayed cyclotomic product. Residue contents must be nonzero. No free diagonal gives Qmin=(N+1)/2 for every odd N.
